signals.title: EUR/JPY — G10 Bilateral Theme + Yield Disadvantage
signals.text: EUR Leveraged Funds net short of -82.4k contracts (6th percentile, z=-1.65) anchors broad downside as JPY emerges as the week's strongest G10 currency against the laggard euro. JPY 1W avg +1.043% (n=7) versus EUR -0.720% (n=9) creates an extreme 1.763% leader-laggard spread, with heavy EUR/JPY options downside demand reflected in a -2.42 25-delta risk reversal skew. The Tokyo session open and Japan Services PMI are the catalysts resolving downside follow-through into the 30 Oct BoJ meeting. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/JPY on open. Catalyst: Tokyo session open and Japan au Jibun Bank Services PMI (00:30 UTC). Risk: EUR/JPY rebound above the 178.50 zone invalidated by hawkish ECB commentary.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Soft US Payrolls vs Extreme Net-Short Crowding
signals.text: EUR COT Leveraged Funds net short of -82.4k contracts (pctl 6, z=-1.65) confronts sharp US rate repricing after Friday's weak 29k non-farm payrolls print. Downside momentum halted at 1.1257 Friday close as Fed October rate hike pricing collapsed, challenging the USD OIS carry advantage of +122bp. The Sydney and Tokyo liquidity return is the catalyst determining whether short-covering squeezes EUR/USD back toward its 20-day SMA at 1.1464 ahead of the 28 Oct FOMC meeting. Trade bias: Bullish squeeze on EUR/USD into the open. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo open followed by Euro Area Services PMI at 08:00 UTC. Risk: Spot break below Friday closing low near 1.1240 accelerates the multi-month downtrend.
evidence: US Sep Payrolls missed expectations (29k jobs report)

signals.title: USD/CAD — Extreme Short Positioning vs Divergent Rate Bets
signals.text: CAD COT Leveraged Funds net short of -72.5k contracts (23.8% long) sets up elevated short-covering risk as spot holds extended at Friday's 1.4245 close. Fed holds at 4.00%. US ISM Non-Manufacturing PMI on Monday is the catalyst testing USD/CAD resilience ahead of the 28 Oct BoC meeting. Trade bias: Bearish USD/CAD on carry compression and technical exhaustion above SMA200 (1.3854). Catalyst: US ISM Non-Manufacturing PMI (14:00 UTC). Risk: Break and hold above 1.4300 triggered by fresh risk-off crude liquidation.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Leveraged Long Unwind Risk
signals.text: AUD COT Leveraged Funds net long of +55.1k contracts (72.3% long, pctl 79) faces severe liquidation risk following Friday's close at 0.6957 below all key daily moving averages. Despite a 73bp OIS carry advantage favoring AUD (AONIA 4.60% vs SOFR 3.87%), spot remains suppressed beneath the 20-day SMA (0.7089) as AUD 1W performance dropped -0.581% across G10. The Sydney open and Australia S&P Global Services PMI serve as the catalyst to test support ahead of the 3 Nov RBA meeting. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD toward 0.6900 on long liquidation. Catalyst: Australia S&P Global Services PMI at 22:00 UTC. Risk: Rebound above the 0.7033 200-day SMA invalidates the downside unwind.
evidence: SMA positioning: below SMA20 (0.7089), SMA50 (0.7094), SMA200 (0.7033)

signals.title: GBP/USD — Gilt-Treasury Yield Support vs Short Crowding
signals.text: GBP Leveraged Funds net short of -5.4k contracts sits at the 2nd percentile (z=-2.34), creating immediate squeeze conditions after Friday's rally to 1.3240. The 10-year UK gilt yield closed at 5.38% (+10bp over US 10Y Treasuries), supporting GBP resilience as Fed rate hike bets abate following the weak US jobs release. The UK S&P Global Services PMI is the catalyst testing upside momentum ahead of the 5 Nov BoE meeting. Trade bias: Bullish GBP/USD on open. Catalyst: UK S&P Global/CIPS Services PMI at 08:30 UTC. Risk: Decline below 1.3200 driven by UK fiscal concerns.
